description: Tells mttr what you did on a site, after each step: what you planned, changed, checked, or where you got stuck, what you found along the way, the files you touched and the rules you worked on. It shows on your person’s progress page, and mttr reads these to get better. Never send secrets or a site’s private data.

did.description: What was done, in a sentence or two.

files.description: The files touched, separated by commas.

found.description: What you found along the way, such as what was true of the site’s code.

proposal.description: The proposal this step carried out or checked, by its id from mttr_propose, when the site works by approval.

rules.description: The mttr rules worked on, by id, separated by commas.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.

name: mttr_log_work
title: Log work on a site
